quick.summary: How to format messages so people take action immediately.
quick.takeaway: Put the most important action at the very top.

beats.line: I sent a whole page about the pipeline error. Why did nobody restart it?
Think of a stop sign on the road. It just says stop.
It does not explain the history of intersections.
Right. Readers need the action right away. Do not bury it.
Some call this cognitive load reduction.
Can I just say make it scannable?
I agree. Make it scannable. Put the action up top.
Job failed. Click here to restart. The logs go below.
Now they will actually click it.

quiz.question: You need a team to update their passwords. Where do you put the link?
options: At the top of the message.
At the bottom of the message.
quiz.explanation: Putting the action at the very top ensures people see it before they stop reading.

quiz.question: Giving background first makes people read faster.
quiz.explanation: Background delays the point. Give the action first, then the background.
